records.title: ANU Chancellor's International Scholarship
records.deadline_display: Application period is open all year round. However, the official page currently states "The scholarship is currently unavailable" and lists the application period as "Application closed".
records.application_period: Open all year round; automatic consideration upon admission application

records.title: International Talents @unibo — Scholarships for International Students Enrolling in Second Cycle Degree Programmes
records.official_source: Alma Mater Studiorum – Università di Bologna
records.deadline_display: Applications for the 2025/26 edition closed at 12:00 CEST on 30 May 2025 ("scadenza: 30 maggio 2025, 12:00"); the call is published annually and no open window was visible on bandi.unibo.it on 4 October 2026.
records.application_period: Annual call, opening in mid-January and closing at 12:00 CEST in late May (17 January 2025 12:00 CET to 30 May 2025 12:00 CEST for the 2025/26 edition); results published in July

records.title: ANU University Research Scholarship
records.deadline_display: Round 1 (commencement by end of March the following year): International application deadline 31 August; Domestic application deadline 31 October. Round 2: commencement by end of August the same year. No separate application is required.
records.application_period: ANU states the application period is open all year round, with consideration organised into two annual central rounds. Round 1 international applications close 31 August and domestic applications 31 October for commencement by the end of March the following year; Round 2 is for commencement by the end of August the same year.

records.title: ANU Vice-Chancellor's International Achievement Award
records.deadline_display: Application period: Open for applications. ANU publishes no closing date for this award; consideration is automatic with the admissions application.
records.application_period: Continuous. ANU's scholarship page shows the application period as 'Open for applications' with no closing date, because no separate scholarship application is required: all eligible students applying for admission to commence at the University are considered automatically.

records.title: Wellcome Early-Career Award
records.deadline_display: There are no deadlines for applications to this scheme. Applications can be submitted at any time. Apply anytime - Applications are accepted year-round.
records.application_period: Rolling, applications accepted year-round. Location eligibility changes on 29 October 2026: from that date applications are only accepted from lead applicants based at eligible administering organisations in the UK and low- and middle-income countries in Africa, South Asia and South-East Asia. Applications submitted on or before 28 October 2026 are assessed under the current location eligibility requirements.

records.title: New Zealand Refugee Health Scholarship
records.official_source: Immigration New Zealand (Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment)
records.application_period: The 2027 intake opened 1 July 2026 and closed 1 October 2026. The first intake opened 15 October 2025. The programme is described as multi-year and annual, so the next window is expected to open in July 2027, but no 2028 closing date is published.

records.title: Organization of American States (OAS) Scholarship at Colorado State University
records.official_source: Colorado State University International Enrollment Center, in partnership with the Organization of American States
records.deadline_display: No closing date published - the OAS announcement lists 'Rolling admission' for CSU bachelor's programmes and states that graduate admission deadlines vary; applications are being taken for newly admitted Fall 2027 students
records.application_period: Applications are being accepted for newly admitted students entering Fall 2027; the OAS announcement records rolling admission for bachelor's programmes and instructs applicants to contact CSU International for graduate deadlines
